videos.title: Fine-Tune, Deploy & Serve Open LLMs with Crusoe Intelligence Foundry
videos.description:
github code: https://github.com/sourangshupal/crusoe-cloud-video-demo

Try Crusoe with free credits:https://fandf.co/4fHu0hk

Managing GPU infrastructure shouldn't slow down AI development. In this video, I demonstrate how to build a complete LLM fine-tuning and deployment pipeline using Crusoe Intelligence Foundry, from dataset preparation to production inference—all without provisioning or managing GPUs.

Using a synthetic financial PII dataset, we fine-tune Qwen3 8B, compare it against Llama 3.3 70B, and deploy the resulting model to a dedicated production endpoint using Crusoe's managed AI platform.

What you'll learn

✅ Understand Crusoe Cloud and Crusoe Intelligence Foundry
✅ Prepare a Hugging Face dataset for supervised fine-tuning
✅ Fine-tune Qwen3 8B using Serverless Fine-Tuning
✅ Monitor training jobs and model metrics
✅ Run Serverless Inference using an OpenAI-compatible API
✅ Deploy a fine-tuned model with Self-Serve Deployments
✅ Compare dedicated deployments vs serverless inference
✅ Download LoRA adapter weights for complete portability
✅ Evaluate model performance using Detection F1 and Typed F1

Technologies Covered

* Crusoe Intelligence Foundry
* Crusoe Cloud
* Serverless Fine-Tuning
* Serverless Inference
* Self-Serve Deployments
* Qwen3 8B
* Llama 3.3 70B
* LoRA Fine-Tuning
* Hugging Face Datasets
* OpenAI Python SDK
* Production LLM Deployment

This tutorial is ideal for AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, and developers looking to build production-ready LLM applications without the complexity of managing GPU infrastructure.

📌 Disclosure: This video is sponsored by Crusoe Cloud. All opinions and the hands-on demonstration are my own.

videos.title: Khloé Kardashian on the 3 Years She Was Too Ashamed to Leave Her House
videos.description:
Khloé Kardashian says the shame she carried for years was never really hers to carry.

In this clip, Khloé Kardashian and Jay Shetty talk about the stretch of her life where she didn't want to make eye contact with anyone at the grocery store, convinced they already knew her story and had decided what she deserved.

Khloé opens up about the therapist she avoided for over ten years, the homework assignment that made her read her own traumas out loud like a stranger's biography, and why she kept apologizing every time she cried. She talks about forgiving herself for staying, setting boundaries for the first time at 40, and what actually changed the morning she started choosing her own mood.

Learn about why she still believes in marriage after everything, what happened when she sat down with Lamar for the first time in almost ten years, and the sentence her six-year-old wrote about her that stopped her cold.
